Which word equation represents the rusting of iron?
iron + oxygen + water → anhydrous iron(II) hydroxide
A
iron + oxygen → hydrated iron(II) oxide
B
iron + oxygen + water → anhydrous iron(III) hydroxide
C
iron + oxygen + water → hydrated iron(III) oxide
D

options.label: A
options.text: iron + oxygen + water → anhydrous iron(II) hydroxide

options.label: C
options.text: iron + oxygen + water → anhydrous iron(III) hydroxide

options.label: D
options.text: iron + oxygen + water → hydrated iron(III) oxide
